name: AutoDock Vina
description: Docks a set of representative molecules (e.g. the keep-list that survived structure-alerts / compound-clustering triage) into a protein receptor with AutoDock Vina and ranks them by predicted binding affinity. Receptor PDB is prepped automatically (waters stripped, hydrogens + Gasteiger charges added, converted to a rigid PDBQT via OpenBabel); each ligand SMILES is embedded to 3D (RDKit ETKDG + MMFF) and prepared with Meeko. The search box is given explicitly (center + size in Angstrom) or derived from a reference ligand. Returns per-molecule best/per-pose affinities and an affinity ranking; optionally writes docked-pose SDFs and a score chart.

input_schema.title: autodock-vina inputs
input_schema.description: Ligands to dock plus the protein receptor. `compounds` is the list of representative molecules ({smiles, id}); the worker resolves an uploaded/pasted SMILES file to it. `receptor` is a protein structure file (PDB) which the worker hands the tool as `receptor_file`.

compounds.description: List of {smiles, id} ligand objects; both fields required, ids unique

receptor.description: Protein receptor structure file (PDB). Uploaded/selected by the user; the worker hands the tool the resolved path as `receptor_file`.

output_schema.title: autodock-vina result
output_schema.description: Dict returned by run(...) and written to /work/output/result.json. Pose SDFs and scores.png (when requested) are written under /work/output/ as well.

affinity.description: Best (most negative) predicted binding affinity, kcal/mol

rank.description: 1-based rank by best affinity (1 = strongest binder)

pose_affinities.description: Affinity of every returned pose, kcal/mol

pose_file.description: Filename of the docked-pose SDF under output/ (only when write_poses=true)

ranking.description: Compound ids ordered by best affinity, strongest binder first

errors.description: Compounds that could not be prepared or docked, with the reason

images.description: Present only when render_scores was requested. Maps 'scores' to scores.png, or 'scores_error' to the reason a render was skipped.

search_box.description: Docking search box. Leave it unset to dock a default-size box centred on the receptor; set center_x/y/z to target a known pocket, or box_from_ref to derive the box from a reference ligand.

center_x.description: Box center X (Angstrom). Defaults to the receptor centroid.

center_y.description: Box center Y (Angstrom). Defaults to the receptor centroid.

center_z.description: Box center Z (Angstrom). Defaults to the receptor centroid.

box_from_ref.description: Derive the box center/size from a reference ligand's bounding box instead of center/size.

reference_ligand.description: Path to a reference ligand structure (PDB/PDBQT) used when box_from_ref is set.

ref_padding.description: Padding (Angstrom) added around the reference ligand bounding box.

exhaustiveness.description: Vina search effort. Higher is more thorough but slower (8 default; 16-32 for production).

num_modes.description: Maximum number of binding poses to return per ligand.

energy_range.description: Max energy difference (kcal/mol) between the best and worst returned pose.

ph.description: pH for hydrogen addition during ligand & receptor prep.

remove_waters.description: Strip crystallographic waters from the receptor before docking.

remove_hetero.description: Strip all heteroatoms (cofactors, ions, ligands) from the receptor, not just waters.

write_poses.description: Write each ligand's docked poses to an SDF artifact under output/.

render_scores.description: Render a horizontal bar chart of best affinity per molecule to scores.png.
